Hotel Maa Sharda Palace is a 2.5-star property located in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India.
Exact Address: Indore-Ujjain Rd, near Navgrah Shani Mandir, Gothada, Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh 456010.
Phone: +91 91091 03571
WhatsApp: +91 91091 03571

Proximity: The hotel is located approximately 5 km from Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, making it an excellent choice for Hindu pilgrims.
Room Count: 65+ rooms in total.
Room Types:
1. Deluxe Double Room (approx. 108 sq ft, sleeps 2)
2. Deluxe Triple Room (approx. 162 sq ft, sleeps 3)
3. Family Room (approx. 250 sq ft, sleeps 4+)
All rooms include air conditioning, private bathrooms, work desks, and free WiFi.

Amenities: Indoor swimming pool, gym, 3 banquet halls, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, free parking, elevator.
Banquet Halls: Grand Sharda Banquet (up to 500 guests), Royal Celebration Hall (up to 250 guests), Intimate Meeting Room (up to 50 guests).

For bookings, visit our website or contact us directly.
